actions.action: Separate quotation verification from speaker verification
actions.mechanism: Explicit review states prevent verified wording from implying verified identity; unknown remains a valid speaker value.
actions.implementation: Show attribution status beside search results and saved quotes. Require reviewer confirmation for verified identity; export unresolved identities as “Speaker unknown—attribution unverified.”
actions.check: Verify wording while leaving the speaker unresolved; confirm search, collections, and exports never present the imported name as verified.
actions.risk: A single combined verification badge would recreate ambiguity.

actions.action: Propagate corrections through append-only quote revisions
actions.mechanism: Stable quote references resolve current corrections while immutable revisions preserve what researchers previously saved or exported.
actions.implementation: Retain imported text and labels. Append corrections with reviewer identity, reason, and prior revision. Collections retain saved revisions while displaying current values and change notices.
actions.check: Correct a speaker after saving the quote in two collections; both update visibly, while prior revisions and reviewer identities remain retrievable.
actions.risk: Silent updates could conceal consequential attribution changes.

actions.action: Anchor quotes across segments to reviewed audio
actions.mechanism: Ordered source spans and separately reviewed audio bounds avoid treating unreliable segment timestamps as authoritative quote boundaries.
actions.implementation: Store each quote’s segment IDs, text offsets, recording ID, and revisioned audio intervals. Provide contextual playback and adjustable bounds; export a resolving audio link with interval-review status.
actions.check: Save a boundary-crossing quote with an unresolved speaker; adjust incorrect bounds and verify its export replays the complete passage without asserting identity.
actions.risk: Unavailable recordings or restrictive permissions can break playback.
